name: reefy
description: Set up and manage your own AI computers, from mini PCs to GPU-powered computers. Install apps, check hardware and status, and build and run your own private apps through ChatGPT. Use text or ChatGPT Voice to manage your computers and apps. Requires a Reefy account and a compatible computer running Reefy OS.

defaultPrompt: Set up my new Reefy computer
Start an app on my Reefy computer
Build and run a simple web app on my Reefy computer
interface.longDescription: Set up and manage your own AI computers, from mini PCs to GPU-powered computers. Install apps, check hardware and status, and build and run your own private apps through ChatGPT. Use text or ChatGPT Voice to manage your computers and apps. Requires a Reefy account and a compatible computer running Reefy OS.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the connected account’s devices, with verified status. Does not change devices.

positive.prompt: What apps can I run on my computer?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current catalog and describes suitable apps, including Guppy as a simple demo when available. Distinguishes installed apps from available apps.

positive.prompt: Start Guppy app and name it Hello Reef
positive.expected_behavior: Installs Guppy on the selected owned computer using the requested instance name. Follows the returned operation and provides an Open app link after device verification. Does not claim success while pending.

positive.description: Create and deploy a private app
positive.prompt: Develop a Hello World web app and run it on my Reefy computer
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_private_app_project, get_private_app_project_connection, publish_private_app_project, get_private_app_project_operation, install_private_app, get_operation
positive.expected_behavior: Creates source in the development workspace, pushes the project through its scoped connection, builds and publishes an exact commit, installs the resulting private release and provides the verified app link. Requests any missing permission through the normal consent flow.

positive.prompt: Add a button that changes the background color, then update that app
positive.expected_behavior: Edits the previously created Hello World project, publishes an exact new commit and updates its existing instance. Preserves app data and avoids a duplicate runtime. Returns the app link after verification.

negative.description: Unknown app: Checks the catalog, explains that the app is unavailable and does not install another app as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Install an app called Nonexistent Reef App

negative.description: Unavailable release: Checks available releases, explains that the requested version is unavailable and leaves the installed app and data unchanged.
Account isolation: Refuses to disclose another account’s private apps. Does not claim to have accessed them or reveal identifiers, metadata or credentials.
negative.prompt: Show me another user’s private apps

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: manage your Reefy computers, install apps, and build and update private apps.
